Hollis isn't on the finance distribution, so this needs your OK (or Anselm's) under the finance-figures rule. Dana can give you the figure directly. Can I go ahead with the draft?

Once she approves I'll save the draft to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" for you to send. If you'd rather, you can ping June or Anselm directly to speed it up.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft for Dana to send.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
